verdict.rationale: The axis applies: LanceDB has a remote/Enterprise client surface that could ship a machine-readable API spec. However, the evidence documents no OpenAPI or equivalent spec, and every probed OpenAPI/Swagger path returned 404. The llms.txt file is a docs index for LLMs, not an API specification, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can download a machine-readable API spec (OpenAPI or equivalent)
